description: This Java class 'Path2IAR' processes a directory structure, generates an XML-like grouping of files and folders, and writes the output to a file named 'group.txt'. It traverses the directory tree starting from a specified relative path, filters for specific source files (.cpp, .c, .h), and constructs a hierarchical representation including folder and file names.

classes.name: Path2IAR
classes.description: Main class for processing directory structure and generating an XML-like grouping description for firmware files used in IAR (Embedded development environment).

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, initiates processing from the relative directory and outputs the results.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Recursively processes a directory, constructs XML-like groupings, and filters source files.
